title: Creative Content Lead
company: Travail Employment Group - Burgess Hill - Agency - Permanent
description:
Creative Content Lead
£35,000 - £40,000, Haywards Heath, Monday to Friday, full-time, permanent, 20 days holiday rising with service, HealthShield cash plan, wellbeing benefits, staff discount, company events

The Role
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Content & Creative Lead to join an established premium consumer brand in Haywards Heath. Working as part of the wider marketing and creative function and reporting to the Head of Retail, this is a hands-on position for someone who loves turning creative ideas into beautiful, commercially effective content. You will take ownership of day-to-day creative output across digital, paid media and print, while helping ensure every customer touchpoint reflects the quality and aspirational feel of the brand.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Create high-quality digital and static content for paid advertising campaigns across platforms including Meta and Google Performance Max
- Develop creative concepts and turn ideas into engaging, on-brand campaign assets
- Review paid media performance to understand which creative concepts are working and use these insights to continually improve future content
- Produce and manage digital and print assets including magazine advertising, point-of-sale materials and other above-the-line campaigns
- Support the planning and production of direct mail campaigns, considering audience, product focus, messaging and storytelling
- Coordinate photoshoots and content capture, ensuring post-shoot assets are edited and ready for use across relevant channels
- Edit video content and support the development of engaging video creative, where experience allows
- Use AI tools appropriately to increase creative output, develop variations and support planning and analysis
- Act as a guardian of the brand's visual identity, maintaining brand guidelines and ensuring content feels consistent across every customer touchpoint
- Work with external agencies, media partners and suppliers to ensure creative is delivered effectively and to deadline
- Support and develop a Junior Graphic Designer, helping to prioritise workload and maximise the creative resource available within the team
- Research emerging creative opportunities and channels, helping the brand explore areas such as TikTok, AI advertising and future media opportunities

Requirements
Previous experience within a hands-on creative, graphic design or content role is necessary, ideally with around three years or more experience in a commercially focused environment. Strong graphic design skills and proficiency with Adobe InDesign are highly desirable, alongside the ability to confidently create professional assets beyond template-led platforms such as Canva. Experience creating static content for paid advertising and an understanding of how creative can influence campaign performance would also be highly desirable.

You will be an ideas-driven and proactive creative who enjoys implementing your work rather than solely developing strategy. Experience within a premium, luxury, aspirational or high-consideration consumer environment would be desirable, although applications from other sectors with an appropriate creative style are welcomed. Video editing, shoot production, AI creative tools and previous mentoring or management experience would be advantageous but are not essential.

This role could suit someone who has worked as a Senior Graphic Designer, Senior Creative Designer or Creative Content Manager.

Company Information
Our client is an established and highly regarded premium consumer brand with a strong emphasis on beautiful design, aspirational content and an exceptional customer experience. The business has built a distinctive visual identity and places creativity at the heart of how it communicates with its customers.

You will join a collaborative marketing and creative environment where ideas are encouraged and where the Content & Creative Lead will have the opportunity to influence how the brand evolves across established and emerging channels. This is particularly well suited to someone who wants creative ownership while remaining close to the hands-on design and production work they enjoy.

Package
- £35,000 - £40,000 salary
- Permanent position
- Monday to Friday
- 20 days' annual leave, increasing with length of service
- HealthShield cash plan
- Gym and wellbeing credits
- Staff discount
- Summer and Christmas company events
- Family-friendly approach
- Accessible Haywards Heath location with public transport links
- Nearby parking options

Travail Employment Group is operating as an Employment Agency. Once you click to apply for this job your application will be immediately received by Travail Employment Group. If your application is successful a consultant will be in contact with you within the next 7 days. If you do not hear within 7 days you have unfortunately not been successful on this occasion.

title: CRM Marketing Executive
description:
CRM Marketing Executive
A well-established travel organisation is seeking a talented CRM Marketing Executive to join their dynamic team on a 12 month fixed term contract. This role offers the chance to contribute to high-impact marketing campaigns that inspire people to explore the great outdoors and enjoy unforgettable travel experiences. This is a fantastic opportunity for a commercially minded marketer with a passion for CRM, and email campaign delivery to make a meaningful contribution in a fast-paced, purpose driven environment. Salary of £33k to £35k, hybrid working with a minimum of 1 day in the office.

CRM Marketing Executive - Role & Responsibilities:
The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering targeted marketing activity across multiple channels. Working closely with product teams, internal stakeholders, and external agencies, you'll help shape and execute campaigns that drive engagement, bookings, and brand loyalty.
- Planning and delivering multi-channel marketing campaigns, including email, newsletters, app notifications, SMS, print, and digital
- Working with CRM agency to segment audiences and deliver personalised messaging
- Collaborating with product managers and marketing leads to identify priorities and optimise campaign performance
- Developing and managing marketing communication plans, ensuring timely execution across all channels
- Writing and presenting briefs to internal teams and external partners
- Monitoring campaign performance against KPIs and recommending improvements
- Creating and curating content across media platforms, including copywriting and image sourcing
- Proofreading and ensuring accuracy of all outbound communications
- Contributing to market research and competitor analysis

CRM Marketing Executive - Skills & Experience Required:
- Marketing or related degree
- Minimum 3 years' experience in a B2 C marketing role, ideally within the travel or leisure industry
- Strong background in CRM and digital . / email campaign delivery
- Experience and ability to brief specialist CRM agency
- Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Experience working with internal stakeholders and external agencies
- Commercially astute with the ability to interpret data and generate insights
- Highly organised, proactive, and able to work independently
- Strong copywriting skills and attention to detail

CRM Marketing Executive - Additional Info & Key Benefits:
- Initial 12 month fixed term contract
- Salary £33k to £35k depending on experience
- Hybrid working, with a minimum of 1 day in the office after initial induction
- Inclusive and supportive working culture

title: Digital Marketing and Website Executive

Crowborough, East Sussex

title: Marketing Operations Manager - Fixed-Term Contract
description:
Marketing Operations Manager - Fixed-Term Contract
East Grinstead, West Sussex
£50,000 per annum (pro rata)
Monday - Friday, 40 hours a week, worked 9am - 6pm

About us

An award-winning, market-leading 3 PL (third-party logistics provider), ILG specialises in high-quality order fulfilment and delivery services. Our customers are premium brands, many in the beauty, fashion and wellbeing sectors. Our mission is to help them succeed.

We are a people business, investing in training and development, recognising and rewarding our people's achievements and creating opportunities for them to progress within our business. If you want to develop an exciting career, learn from a friendly team and realise your full potential in a fast-growing company, this is the role for you.

The role

As Marketing Operations Manager, you'll be at the heart of how our marketing activity works, making sure our systems, data and processes are set up to deliver results.

You'll take ownership of HubSpot CRM and Marketing Hub, ensuring leads are tracked effectively, automation runs smoothly, and we have clear insight into how marketing is contributing to our pipeline and growth.

Working closely with Marketing and Sales, you will:
- Own and optimise HubSpot CRM and Marketing Hub
- Build and improve marketing automation, workflows and nurture journeys
- Ensure leads are tracked accurately from first touch through to customer
- Manage lead scoring, lifecycle stages and marketing attribution
- Keep marketing data clean, accurate and reliable
- Create dashboards and reporting that turn data into useful insights
- Support campaigns with segmentation, lists and automation
- Look for smarter ways to improve processes and reduce manual activity

Please be aware that this is a 6-month Fixed-Term Contract.

What we are looking for

We're looking for someone who loves making marketing systems work smarter and can turn data into meaningful insight.

You'll ideally have:
- Strong practical experience with HubSpot CRM and Marketing Hub
- Experience with marketing automation, workflows and lead scoring
- A good understanding of attribution and lead tracking
- Strong analytical and data management skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- Experience working with Sales on lead management
- A proactive, organised and solutions-focused approach
- An understanding of GDPR and email marketing compliance

Benefits
- Discretionary company bonus scheme
- Following successful probation period, the opportunity for hybrid working in line with ILG policy up to 50/50 remote/office working
- Pension, Life Assurance, Healthshield Cash Plan and Discount Perks
- 25 days' holiday (plus Bank Holidays)
- Birthday leave
- Free on-site parking, with electric car charging at certain locations
- Range of employee awards
- Regular social events
- Employee assistance programme to promote mental health and wellbeing
- Cycle to work scheme
- Enhanced maternity and paternity leave

Job Application Requirements - We welcome your application and look forward to considering you for this role. Please note the following important requirements for all applicants:
- Right to Work in the UK & Basic DBS Check - You must have the legal right to work in the UK (we are not able to sponsor you). If successful, you will also need to pass a Basic Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check before starting employment. We use a third-party checking service for each of these, so you will need to provide them with relevant information if offered a role with us.
- References - We reserve the right to request two or more references to cover the past five years of your employment history. Please ensure you can provide accurate contact details for each of your referees.
- English Language - You must be able to work in English, enough to fully understand spoken and written work instructions, follow health and safety guidance and participate in discussions with your manager or colleagues.

If you meet the role requirements, as well as the above, and are ready to take the next step in your career, we encourage you to apply.

Please be aware, we will be considering applications as we receive them and arranging interviews accordingly. Depending on the volume of applications we receive, we may close this advert ahead of the advertised closing date.

For more information about our company or employee benefits, please visit our website.
